name: stakeam
description: StakeAm — Nigeria's prediction market. Phase 0 scaffold.

scripts.lint: pnpm -r lint && pnpm run lint:vocabulary && pnpm run lint:wiring
scripts.//typecheck: The apps resolve @stakeam/* through dist, so the libraries have to exist before tsc runs. Without this, typecheck fails on a clean checkout — which is exactly what CI is.

pnpm.//: pnpm 10 blocks lifecycle scripts by default. These need theirs: prisma downloads query engines, argon2 and sharp build/fetch native binaries, esbuild installs its platform binary.
pnpm.//overrides: Transitive advisories the dependency-audit gate refuses. Each is a vulnerable version pulled in by a package we do want (next, prisma), so the fix is a floor here rather than dropping the parent. Reviewed on every bump: if the parent ships a patched range itself, the override should go.

//scale-trigger: kafkajs — architecture §12 scale trigger ONLY. Deliberately NOT installed in Phase 0. Add to apps/api dependencies when the events table / trade fan-out exceeds what Redis Streams can carry, and not before.
